blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: Override culture
Override culture — guarded because operators can reject any recommendation in one tap — rejections are mined weekly, not punished
OT/IT blur
OT/IT blur: control traffic never crosses zones without a broker; laptops do not talk to PLCs; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
Twin decay
Twin decay: models are recalibrated against plant truth every shift; a drifting twin loses control authority automatically; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
